historyInstance_help: The history adapter that records the states below (history, influxdb or sql).
days_help: 1 to 28. A week (7) repeats your normal weekly routine.
jitter_help: Each change moves up to this many seconds earlier or later, so the pattern is not an exact copy. 0 to 1800.
restore: Restore the states when the simulation stops
states_help: Lights, plugs or switches. The history instance above must be recording each of them.
name: Name (optional)
triggerId_help: Optional, for example a presence or away-mode state. Without it, switch presence-simulation.0.active yourself.
triggerValue_help: For example AWAY or true. The simulation stops when the state changes to anything else.
